title: Make release-lane tests independent of inherited agent identity
goal: Keep release-lane fixture agents distinct when the release runner exports SUSI_AGENT, so stale-claim and concurrent-lane tests exercise their intended ownership behavior on the exact release gate environment.

results.inherited_agent: SUSI_AGENT=carbon cargo test --offline --locked -p xtask --bin release-lanes -- --nocapture: 33 passed, 0 failed
results.scope: The test-only run_in helper passes each fixture checkout's basename as --agent before --cmd, preserving distinct alice/bob ownership under release-runner environments.

limitations: The fix changes only the release-lanes test helper; production agent identity resolution remains unchanged.
